# SPIRITUS Capital

> SPIRITUS Capital is a private equity platform investing in Scotch whisky and hospitality, with offices in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and Edinburgh. SPIRITUS Capital Fund 1 is an ADGM Qualified Investor Fund offered by private placement to Professional Clients only. Nothing on this site is an offer or invitation to invest. Capital is at risk.

## The firm
- [Home](https://spiritus.capital/): overview of the platform
- [The Firm](https://spiritus.capital/firm/): who we are and how we work
- [Fund 1](https://spiritus.capital/fund/): the ADGM Qualified Investor Fund
- [Strategy](https://spiritus.capital/strategy/): investment approach in Scotch whisky and hospitality
- [Portfolio](https://spiritus.capital/portfolio/): current and target holdings
- [Team](https://spiritus.capital/team/): partners and leadership
